scope: Technical implementation evidence for individual lessons. This ledger does not establish course completion, independent subject review or learner pilot validation.

teaching.investigation: Predict signed state and qualifying event counts, reveal synchronized displacement/velocity/acceleration and phase-plane plots, move a keyboard time probe, compare full model and recorded-sample tables, and write two contrasting runs using a four-criterion self-check rubric.

independentChecks.generatedCases: Each of 12 variants was checked over at least 50 deterministic seeds, totaling 600 minimum variant-seed cases. Additional coverage checks include all phase representations, sign quadrants, endpoint combinations, directed touches, excluded initial roots, stationary recurrence and constant/Nyquist/interior aliases.
independentChecks.stateReference: Fifty varied initial states are compared with an independent 1800-step Runge-Kutta integration at twelve times per period, plus force and energy/phase-plane identities. Phase reconstruction checks both initial conditions and its principal interval.
independentChecks.eventReference: Fifty trajectories at five interior target positions use an independent 2000-bracket root search with 45 bisection steps per root. Exact-grid generated problems are checked through separately enumerated sine/cosine states. Tests include open/closed boundaries, unique turning points, unreachable targets and late windows near 1000 periods.
independentChecks.answerBehavior: Equivalent exact fractions, radicals and pi expressions, approximate-phase tolerance, invalid/nonfinite input, wrong signs, wrong direction, an extra full period when the first event is requested, and alternate principal intervals are checked. Zero amplitude is separate from nonzero motion.

teaching.investigation: Predict the small-angle period, nonlinear release energy and period comparison; compare a rigid-rod pendulum's sine and linear models, both energy accounts and two integration steps. Keyboard probes, all-state paginated tables, crossing evidence and a five-criterion self-check rubric support three contrasting runs plus step refinement.

independentChecks.generatedCases: Each of 12 variants passed at least 50 deterministic seeds: 600 minimum variant-seed cases. Additional coverage checks include positive/zero/negative energy under a specified reference, series/parallel constraints, all turning bounds, parameter scaling, rod/disk pivot inertias, torsion, positive/negative/zero curvature, both stable and unstable quartic equilibria, and force-versus-period tolerance outcomes.
independentChecks.stateReference: Fifty amplitudes are checked against independent 4000-panel energy-integral quadrature; fifty trajectories are compared with a separate velocity-Verlet integration at 16384 steps per small-angle period. Tests also check the analytic linear solution, crossing times, refinement and energy accounts.
independentChecks.answerReference: Linear-force work integration, separate series-spring energies, vertical combined-potential differences, numerical extended-body inertia integrals, force/curvature finite differences and independent sine-series/period quadrature verify answers. Tests reject missing roots, wrong directions, inappropriate local-force substitution, negative formal kinetic requirements presented as states, invalid units/nonfinite input and incorrect interpretation.
independentChecks.smallAngle: At 15 degrees the release-force discrepancy relative to the linear force is 1.138407053463076%, while the period increase is 0.4300579173465158%. Tests keep these distinct from numerical period error and energy drift.
independentChecks.guided: Independent Simpson integration of the restoring force confirms the guided potential difference and kinetic energy, including both velocity roots and the excluded half-meter position.

teaching.investigation: Predict damping rate, initial energy and regime; compare displacement, phase plane and energy-transfer plots, analytic events and every sampled state at two resolutions. A keyboard probe and five-criterion rubric support common-state comparisons, a critical-crossing counterexample, band-entry analysis and quadrature refinement.

independentChecks.generatedCases: Each of 12 variants passed at least 50 deterministic seeds: 600 minimum variant-seed cases. Checks include both initial conditions, phase quadrants, pure overdamped modes, zero damping, peak spacing and cycle counts, instantaneous power, non-exponential exact energy, finite-record settling and uncertainty-bounded model rejection.
independentChecks.stateReference: Fifty varied trajectories are checked against an independent 2-by-2 matrix exponential. Fifty near-critical cases check continuity from both sides. Fifty parameter sets with both pure overdamped modes check relative accuracy and absence of spurious late events. Separate 16384-step Runge-Kutta trajectories and power integrals cover fifty cases.
independentChecks.eventReference: Fifty initial-value problems compare analytic zero and extremum times with independent matrix-state bracketing and bisection. Further fixtures cover included endpoints, all-zero states, signed extrema, same-sign peak decrements, and critical/overdamped single crossings.
independentChecks.answerReference: Generated state and energy answers use separate numerical ODE fixtures; printed sampled records are checked against independently integrated normalized states. Peak-report diagnoses use independently constructed worst-case ratio and timing intervals. Tests cover exact equivalents, invalid/nonfinite or unit-bearing input, logarithm domains, wrong signs, missing roots, incorrect interpretations and explicit small-value tolerances.
independentChecks.guidedAndExamples: The guided critical crossing and authored underdamped, critical and overdamped numerical examples are checked against a separate 16384-step integration. Independent work/energy calculations verify the phase-dependent energy example, the peak fit, uncertainty contradiction and sufficient future containment.
independentChecks.numericalCorrections: Pure fast-mode reference checks exposed cancellation in a naive combined state expression and a spurious late extremum from rounded initial-acceleration coefficients. The delivered evaluator uses modal terms where appropriate and original modal coefficients for event equations.

teaching.investigation: Predict amplitude, phase and the selected output peak; compare a complete frequency sweep with exact characteristic events, startup and particular states, and independent energy-transfer integrals. Two keyboard probes, complete sweep/state/cycle tables and a five-criterion self-check rubric support transient, damping and singular-limit comparisons.

independentChecks.generatedCases: Each of 12 variants passed at least 50 deterministic seeds, totaling 600 minimum variant-seed cases. Extra coverage includes phase quadrants, both initial conditions, static and zero-force states, persistent undamped motion, secular resonance, separate displacement/velocity/power peaks, the no-interior-peak threshold, half-power points and startup versus periodic cycle work.
independentChecks.stateReference: Fifty varied states are compared with an independent 16384-step Runge-Kutta solution at multiple times across every damping regime. Fifty exact-resonance fixtures check the analytic secular solution and nearby frequencies. Tiny positive damping, near-critical continuity, constant forcing and zero forcing are included; an extreme 12-period case uses 65536 reference steps.
independentChecks.energyReference: Fifty cases compare independent four-state ODE integrations of displacement, velocity, input work and viscous loss with the delivered matrix-exponential state and separate power quadrature. Refinement, endpoint balances, startup-cycle means, negative instantaneous input power and periodic mean power are checked independently.
independentChecks.resonanceReference: Separate derivative signs and bounded maximum searches verify output-specific peaks. Independent bisection verifies both half-power frequencies; numerical period integrals verify mean power and cycle work. Boundary damping, very narrow peaks, outside-sweep half-power points and finite free-cycle energy loss are explicit fixtures.
independentChecks.answers: Tests check equivalent exact fractions, radicals and pi expressions, numeric tolerance boundaries, invalid and nonfinite input, wrong phase quadrants/signs, missing initial corrections, false steady-state claims and incorrect peak interpretations. A complex exact input is valid syntax but incorrect for a real expected answer.
independentChecks.authored: Four content tests independently verify all printed state/work examples and guided answers, including the first startup cycle, near-resonant finite-time limit and static critical response. These tests use separate ODE and integral references rather than reading expected answers from the generated solution.
